create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with a database, template, function names, and test inputs
analyse_sample: analyse a generated code sample by compiling it and running it against test inputs
trim_function_body: trim a generated function body by extracting valid code and removing trailing syntax errors
sample_to_program: convert generated code into a compiled function and full runnable program from a template
check_ancestor_calls: check whether a generated program calls an earlier version of the evolved function
